slides.title: Better boards. Precision craft.

slides.title: The board inside decides

slides.title: No showroom. No middlemen.

materials.title: Your cabinets are only as good as
materials.desc: Most quotes hide the spec. We publish it. Every carcass, edge and finish below is what we actually ship — and what your quote is measured against.

cards.title: Multi-layer plywood core
cards.desc: 18 mm hardwood plywood, cross-laminated in 11 layers. Twice the screw-holding strength of particle board, so doors stay aligned for years.

cards.title: Moisture-proof green core
cards.desc: 720 kg/m³ HDF with a wax-infused core for bathrooms, laundry rooms and vanities. 24-hour water swelling under 8%.

cards.title: E0 / ENF formaldehyde
cards.desc: Emission ≤ 0.025 mg/m³ — lower than most panels sold as “green”. Safe for nurseries, bedrooms and closed kitchens.

cards.title: Seamless PUR edge banding
cards.desc: 1 mm ABS edge, reactive PUR hot-melt, laser-trimmed flush. No glue line, no lifting — even at 60% humidity.

cards.title: Blum & Hettich hardware
cards.desc: Hinges and runners tested to 80,000 open-close cycles. Soft-close on every door and drawer — standard, not an upgrade.

cards.title: Kiln-dried solid wood
cards.desc: Oak, walnut and ash doors dried to 8–10% moisture content, joined with floating tenons to stop seasonal cracking.

specs.label: Carcass core
specs.value: 18 mm multi-layer plywood · E0 / CARB P2

specs.label: Door panels
specs.value: 18–22 mm HDF, solid oak, walnut or ash

specs.label: Edge banding
specs.value: 1 mm ABS · PUR hot-melt · 0.2 mm visible seam

specs.label: Surface finish
specs.value: PET, HPL, PU lacquer or natural veneer · 4H+ scratch

craft.title: Precision you can measure,
craft.desc: Cabinetry is won or lost in millimetres and glue lines. Here is exactly how our production line controls both.

details.title: Nest-cut with matched grain
details.desc: Panels are nested on CNC beds to 0.1 mm, and door fronts are grain-matched before a single board is cut.

details.title: Seamless PUR edges
details.desc: Every edge is bonded with reactive PUR, trimmed flush, then hand-inspected under raking light — no visible glue line.

details.title: Dry-fit before packing
details.desc: Each cabinet is assembled, aligned and labelled by room, then flat-packed with ISTA-3A corner protection.

details.title: Hand-finished surfaces
details.desc: Matte PET and PU lacquer are sanded between coats for a 4H+ surface and 2,000-hour UV fade resistance.

details.title: Twelve sign-offs
details.desc: From board intake to carton sealing, twelve checkpoints. A unit that fails is rebuilt — never patched.

pricing.title: Same specification,
pricing.desc: No showroom rent, no dealer margin, no brand premium. You pay for board, hardware and labour — and you can see every line of it.
bullets: You buy from the factory that builds it — no showroom rent, no dealer margin, no brand premium.
Quotes are itemised by cabinet, so you can compare line by line with any local studio.
Container consolidation keeps freight per unit low, and we quote door-to-door with duties guidance.
Your price is locked for 60 days — and we never swap in a cheaper board after you order.
pricing.note: Indicative 2026 guide prices in USD for comparable specifications. Final quote depends on size, finish and hardware.
